lines.rom: kalaratri jaya jaya mahakali kala ke mumha se bacane vali dusta samgharaka nama tumhara mahacandi tera avatara
prthvi aura akasa pe sara mahakali hai tera pasara khadga khappara rakhane vali dustom ka lahu cakhane vali
kalakatta sthana tumhara saba jagaha dekhum tera najara sabhi devata saba nara nari gavem stuti sabhi tumhari
raktadanta aura annapurna krpa kare to koi bhi duhkha na na koi cinta rahe na bimari na koi gama na samkata bhari
usa para kabhi kasta na ave mahakali mam jise bacave tu bhi bhakta prema se kaha kalaratri mam teri jaya
